issues.evidence: The rock walls are straight rectangular panels; the open top lacks a rear rock canopy and reads as a quarry.（岩壁矩形外框過直、缺少局部洞頂，較像露天採石場。）
issues.fix: Shape the wall outline and add a supported rear canopy, retaining the agreed cutaway.

issues.evidence: Entrance and inner support shoes intersect the left rail, corroborated by overlap candidates.（支架柱腳與左軌重疊。）
issues.fix: Widen and offset the same timber frames to clear both rails.

issues.evidence: The rotated top camera crops the floor corners.（旋轉俯視鏡頭裁掉地板角落。）
issues.fix: Align the overview with world axes and preserve a margin.

issues.evidence: Bright neutral lighting weakens the crystal focal hierarchy.（全場過亮，水晶焦點不明確。）
issues.fix: Reduce broad fill and use restrained local crystal light.

issues.evidence: The rear canopy reads detached at the right wall and remains a broad slab.（後方岩頂在右側有接合間隙，輪廓偏板狀。）
issues.fix: Reduce canopy depth/thickness and raise the supporting right rock wall.

issues.evidence: The canopy hides the rear crystal bases in the top view.（俯視時岩頂遮擋後方水晶底部。）
issues.fix: Shorten the canopy to keep the crystal zone visible in the cutaway.

issues.evidence: The layout check flags one loose ore fragment intersecting the left boulder.（配置檢查指出一塊碎礦與左側岩塊重疊。）
issues.fix: Move that single fragment into the nearby free ground.

issues.evidence: The hero and secondary views retain a broad slab-like rear canopy silhouette, despite improved attachment.（主視角與次視角的後部岩頂仍偏板狀，接合已改善。）
issues.fix: Future user-authorized work could use a shaped continuous tunnel cross-section instead of modular slabs.
